title: PR's "117/119 T2 PNGs pixel-identical" denominator does not match the committed T2 corpus (113); it reconciles only by counting 6 static mock-reference PNGs
location: chunk-goldens.patch (PNG section: exactly goldens/dublin_board/30000ms.png + goldens/dublin_board/90000ms.png of 102 entries) vs goldens/ corpus
evidence:
pr96-body.md (Determinism): "Proven: 117/119 T2 PNGs **pixel-identical** before/after the re-bless; all 49 `.log.bin` differ ONLY in the 8 catalog-hash header bytes".
Committed corpus counts (worktree at 93333cd):
- `git ls-files goldens | grep -c '\.png$'` = 113; demos declare exactly 113 `capture at <ms>` stops (113 expected filenames, 113 committed, after pairing the 0-padded names e.g. 2550ms<->02550ms); corpus file set identical base(370196a)->head (`diff` of ls-tree = SAME).
- The chunk contains exactly 2 PNG entries: "diff --git a/goldens/dublin_board/30000ms.png" / "diff --git a/goldens/dublin_board/90000ms.png" (both "Binary files ... differ").
- docs/captures/dublin-map-mock/ holds exactly 6 PNGs (blender_mid, blender_tilt, blender_zoomin, blender_zoomout, game_baywide, game_templebar) — 113 + 6 = 119; 119 - 2 = 117.
detail: The re-bless evidence itself is consistent (exactly 2 of 113 committed T2s changed), but the claimed tally 117/119 does not describe the T2 corpus it names; the denominator only reaches 119 via 6 non-T2, suite-never-regenerated reference PNGs.
recommended_fix: Restate the PR line as "111/113 committed T2 pixel goldens byte-identical; the 2 dublin_board T2s re-blessed" or explicitly name the 6 mock-reference PNGs folded into the 119 denominator.
